source.title: Consolidation of altered associability information by amygdala central nucleus

confidence_rationale: Post-session CeA inactivation or protein-synthesis block prevents later display of surprise-enhanced associability. Supports associability as a CONSOLIDATED, persistent state rather than a transient online boost -- the half of MECH-598 the claim says to drop if reversal is not faster. Appetitive/omission paradigm; also shows the state is stored outside CeA, so the claim's amygdala subject label is a simplification.
failure_signatures: If post-event consolidation is blocked, the associability enhancement is lost; a mechanism that stores associability instantly at the PE event with no offline consolidation step would not reproduce this.
The stored associability memory is attributed to regions other than CeA (e.g. posterior parietal cortex); a single amygdala-local per-cue state is not what the data show.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Post-surprise CeA activity (anisomycin, lidocaine or muscimol infused after sessions containing a surprising omission) is necessary for consolidating the surprise-enhanced associability memory, interpreted as 'surprise replay' supporting storage elsewhere such as posterior parietal cortex.
mapping.ree_translation: Supports the persistence clause of MECH-598: associability is a stored state that must survive between encounters. It also touches MECH-431 (tag-and-capture) and MECH-074b (replay priority): the associability write appears to need an offline consolidation step. A V3 per-candidate associability vector updated instantly would skip this, which is a simplification the governance routing should note.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Appetitive and omission-induced, as for all this lab's CeA work. The 'surprise replay' interpretation is the authors' inference from timing, not a recorded replay event. The storage locus is elsewhere in cortex, not CeA.
mapping.source_context: Rat serial-prediction task; post-session intra-CeA anisomycin, lidocaine or muscimol

confidence_components.notes: Three converging manipulations in one design gives some robustness. Mapping moderate: persistence maps, locus and valence do not.
